name: EasyThreed K10 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
; EasyThreed K10 - NO HEATED BED, 100x100x100
G90 ; absolute coordinates
M83 ; relative extrusion
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] ; start heating the nozzle
G28 ; home all
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; wait for the nozzle
G92 E0
; prime line along the FRONT edge: the factory raft reaches the left edge
G1 X10 Y2 Z0.3 F1200
G1 X90 Y2 E9 F600
G1 X90 Y3.5 F1200
G1 X10 Y3.5 E9 F600
G92 E0
G1 Z1.0 F600
machine_end_gcode:
; EasyThreed K10 end
G1 E-1.2 F1500 ; retract
G91 ; relative
G1 Z5 F600 ; lift
G90 ; absolute
M104 S0 ; nozzle off
M107 ; fan off
G1 X0 Y95 F2000 ; present the part
M84 ; motors off
